text:
talia: Hey team — quick onboarding calendar question. I have two product tour invites (16:00 UTC and 17:00 UTC) and my iPhone calendar shows them both at the same local time. Also Outlook cut the Zoom passcode from the event body. Where do we keep canonical links/recordings?

owen: Welcome @talia! Canonical recordings go to Google Drive -> New Hires / Recordings. We paste the canonical Zoom link + passcode into the event description after the meeting so Outlook/iOS picks it up.

talia: I checked Drive and I don't see last Thursday's "Security & Infra" recording.

owen: That one's in Private Onboarding while we blank a whiteboard with customer data. Just added you to the ACLs, refresh and you should see it.

kevin: About the duplicate invites 16:00 UTC is the official slot. 17:00 was a saved draft. Safe to delete the extra.

liz: FYI product tour starts 16:00 UTC / 9:00 AM PT / 17:00 BST. We'll upload the recording and drop the link here after the session.

talia: Any idea why Outlook/iPhone strip the passcode? It's annoying.

kevin: Outlook sometimes strips lines that look like passwords. We try to include the passcode in both the description and in the calendar event "Location" field to reduce that. If that fails, we post it in the thread and onboard-bot echoes it.

onboard-bot: Zoom meeting created: ID 555-666-777, passcode: 2408 (auto-posted)

owen: I'll paste the join link into the description and also attach an ICS to the thread so mobile clients have it. If you see timezone weirdness, check Settings -> Time zone and uncheck "Ask to update" on iOS (it can switch zones based on location).

kevin: For nerdy workaround if you use terminal: `TZ=\"America/Los_Angeles\" date -d @$(date +%s)` or `gcalcli agenda \"Onboarding\"` to verify event times. But mostly, accept the invite and check the event description for local rendering.

talia: Thanks 12! One more: who redacts slides? I saw a note about slide 5 having vendor PII.

owen: Marc usually handles redaction. I'll tag him on the file after the session.

liz: I'll scribe notes for the product tour. After we redact, we'll move the cleaned recording to New Hires and update Drive perms.

talia: Great — appreciate the fast answers :thumbsup:
